title: Junior Business Development & Operations (m/w/d)
description:
ÜBER ENPAL

Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Mit unserer integrierten Energielösung und der KI-gestützten Plattform Enpal.One+ gestalten wir die Energiewende und machen erneuerbare Energie für alle zugänglich.

DEINE CHANCE BEI ENPAL

Du willst nicht nur analysieren, sondern selbst etwas aufbauen und sehen, was deine Arbeit bewirkt? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Bei Enpal übernimmst du früh Verantwortung, arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Führungskräften zusammen und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unseres Business aktiv mit. Ob beim Aufbau neuer Vertriebskanäle, der Zusammenarbeit mit Partnern oder der Optimierung bestehender Prozesse - du bringst Ideen in die Umsetzung und erzielst sichtbare Ergebnisse.

Dich erwarten eine steile Lernkurve, kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen.

DEINE AUFGABEN

- Du entwickelst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und unterstützt den Aufbau und die Skalierung kommerzieller Vertriebsmodelle.

- Du übernimmst eigene Projekte - von der Analyse und Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung.

- Du analysierst KPIs, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen ab.

- Du arbeitest mit externen Partnern und internen Teams aus Sales, Operations und Product zusammen.

- Du unterstützt strategische Initiativen und bringst eigene Ideen zur Geschäftsentwicklung ein.

- Du optimierst Prozesse und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen konkrete Ergebnisse werden.

DEIN PROFIL

- Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Management, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

- Du bringst erste relevante Praxiserfahrung mit, beispielsweise durch Praktika oder bis zu etwa ein Jahr Berufserfahrung - idealerweise in Consulting, Startups, Business Development, Finance oder einem analytischen Umfeld.

- Du denkst analytisch, arbeitest strukturiert und findest pragmatische Lösungen.

- Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und überzeugst durch Eigeninitiative und Hands-on-Mentalität.

- Du lernst schnell, denkst unternehmerisch und hast Lust, neue Themen voranzutreiben.

- Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Uns zählen vor allem dein Potenzial, deine Lernbereitschaft und deine Fähigkeit, Dinge eigenständig voranzutreiben.

DARAUF KANNST DU DICH FREUEN

- Ownership ab Tag eins: Übernimm Verantwortung und gestalte echte Business-Projekte aktiv mit.

- Steile Lernkurve: Arbeite eng mit erfahrenen Führungskräften zusammen und entwickle dich fachlich wie persönlich weiter.

- Unternehmerischer Impact: Bring eigene Ideen ein und begleite Projekte von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung.

- Karriereperspektiven: Übernimm neue Themen, erweitere deine Verantwortung und entwickle dich innerhalb von Enpal weiter.

- Startup Spirit & starkes Team: Erlebe kurze Entscheidungswege, ein internationales Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten und regelmäßige Team- und Company-Events.

- Deine Benefits: 29 Urlaubstage plus freie Tage an Heiligabend und Silvester, Wellhub, Corporate Benefits, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und 25 % Rabatt auf Bosch Smart Home Produkte.

- Modernes Office: Freu dich auf unser Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen, Tischtennis und Barista-Coffee.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und gemeinsam mit dir die Energiewende voranzutreiben!

Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor.

title: Loan Servicing Specialist (Private Real Estate Lending)
description:
PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH
Location: Remote, Latin America (LATAM)
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time
Openings: 1
Industry: Real Estate Finance / Private Lending
Compensation: $1,300 to $1,800 USD/month
Experience: 1.5+ years at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender
Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET)
English Proficiency: Advanced written and spoken English required
Start Date: As soon as possible (early November 2026)
About the Company
Our client is a U.S.-based private real estate lender that provides short-term, business-purpose loans to real estate investors.
The company finances Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR rental and Ground-Up Construction projects and works with a third-party loan servicer, note buyers and capital partners to manage its loan portfolio.
As its portfolio grows, the company is building out its remote operations team to keep every funded loan accurately tracked and every borrower well supported.
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Loan Servicing Specialist to own the post-closing servicing workflow and borrower and partner follow-through.
You will board funded loans with the third-party servicer, manage construction draws, monitor maturities, payments and delinquencies, and answer borrower and partner questions until each one is resolved.
The third-party servicer prepares servicing calculations; this specialist reviews and coordinates them. Speed, accuracy, ownership and exceptional borrower service are central to the role.
What You'll Do
Loan Boarding & Records

• Board funded loans with the third-party servicer.

• Validate terms, balances, reserves and maturity dates.

• Maintain accurate records in the company's loan portal and servicing systems.

Construction Draws

• Manage construction draw requests end to end: budget and reserve checks, inspections, documentation, review and approvals within delegated limits.

• Coordinate disbursements and give borrowers proactive updates.

Maturities, Extensions & Payoffs

• Monitor upcoming maturities and coordinate extensions.

• Coordinate payoffs and extensions with the servicer, reviewing its calculations, statements and documents for accuracy.

• Track completion and lien releases.

Portfolio Monitoring

• Identify inactive or stalled loans with no recent progress, updates or borrower communication.

• Contact the relevant parties, document status and escalate risks.

• Monitor missed payments and delinquencies, follow up with borrowers and the servicer, and escalate potential defaults or unresolved issues.

Borrower & Partner Support

• Answer borrower, note buyer and warehouse lender questions about loans, draws, balances, payments, extensions and payoffs.

• Own each inquiry until it is resolved.

Qualifications
Required

• At least 1.5 years of hands-on experience at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender, originating or servicing business-purpose investment property loans (Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR and/or Ground-Up Construction).

• Direct experience servicing short-term hard money or business-purpose loans.

• Experience with construction draw management, payoffs and extensions.

• Advanced written and spoken English.

• High attention to detail.

• Ability to work in Gmail, GoHighLevel (GHL) or a similar CRM, and an online loan portal for documents, files and workflow.

• Hardworking, dependable, proactive and accountable. You take ownership and follow up without reminders.

• Comfortable in a fast-paced lending business, handling urgent requests and meeting deadlines without compromising accuracy or controls.

• Availability to work 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

Preferred

• Experience working with a third-party loan servicer.
Please note: conventional consumer mortgage experience alone (FHA, VA, Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac loans) does not meet the experience requirement.
How Success Is Measured

• Funded loans are boarded quickly and accurately.

• Draw req

title: Finance Business Partner - South West and Wales
description:
We are recruiting a full time Finance Business Partner to join our commercial team at Priory . Reporting to the Managing Director, you’ll take financial responsibility for a portfolio of services across our South West and Wales region, working with senior leaders to improve financial performance, achieve business objectives and identify opportunities for commercial growth. This is a remote role, with the successful candidate required to be based within the region. Frequent travel across South West England and Wales, and to other Priory locations, will be required, including overnight stays. A full UK driving licence is essential. This role is offered on a 12-month fixed-term contract.

What you'll be doing

You will partner with the Managing Director, Hospital Directors and Service Managers to drive financial performance, provide commercial insight and support effective decision-making.
Your responsibilities will include :

• Producing month-end reports, analysing variances and identifying risks and opportunities.

• Managing budgets and forecasts, monitoring performance and recommending corrective action where needed.

• Supporting tenders, pricing, fee uplifts and contract renewals.

• Evaluating business cases and new opportunities to drive commercial growth.

• Maintaining strong financial controls and investigating financial discrepancies.

• Attending monthly business reviews with the Managing Director, recommending actions to improve performance.

• Building financial awareness across services through guidance and training for non-finance colleagues.

• Contributing to wider Group projects and operational improvements.

What you'll bring to the role

You will bring experience as a Commercial Manager, Management Accountant or in a similar finance role, with a strong understanding of financial management and commercial performance. You’ll be confident working autonomously, balancing competing priorities and translating financial insights into practical solutions that improve business performance. With strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, you’ll be able to:

• Identify opportunities to improve financial and commercial performance.

• Build effective relationships with senior leaders and non-finance stakeholders, influencing decisions and driving improvements.

• Translate financial information into clear, actionable recommendations.

• Improve financial awareness and support better decision-making across services.

This position is a leadership role at Priory and during the interview process we will be assessing candidates against our leadership behaviours. These are a set of ten values driven behaviours that define great leadership at Priory . They are integral to driving a positive high performing culture where we strive to deliver the best care and outcomes for the people we support. You can find out more about our interview approach and our leadership behaviours here .

What we will give you in return

We want you to succeed at Priory and thrive in your role. You will be well supported with regular career conversations. We also offer full training and numerous pathways into leadership and qualified clinical positions to help you shape your career with us.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Project Manager - NAM & EMEA
Delivery | Remote, US | Full-Time | NAM
Who We Are: Front Office Transformation Experts
Bluprintx (BPX) is a global, AI-powered consultancy built to design and deliver the intelligent front office for CMO and CRO executives. We are private equity-backed and scaling fast, with 300 active customers across 10 countries and more than 1,750 implementations. We connect people, technology, and AI to turn fragmentation into performance, partnering with global leaders to modernize how marketing, CRM, content, AI & Data connect. At BPX, we hire operators and specialists who thrive at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical execution.
What We Do: Cutting Complexity Across the Front Office
We help the world's most ambitious companies, including Uber Eats, BNY, and Xerox, untangle the operational complexity that slows enterprise growth. As a Gold Adobe Solution Partner and Salesforce Summit Partner, we deliver strategy and implementation across the full front office. Our proprietary methodology builds sustainable enabled ecosystems that maximize ROI and accelerate speed to market. By embedding AI into commercial workflows, we help clients move faster and stay ahead.
The Role
You'll run a portfolio of enterprise client projects across the Adobe and Salesforce ecosystems, taking each one from pitch to plan to delivery. On any given week you'll have several projects live at once, from platform upgrades to full implementations, each with its own technical team and its own client executives. You sit at the center of it: the person our consultants, partner vendors and client leadership all look to for a straight answer on status, risk and what happens next. You also own the numbers, keeping every project on budget and on margin. Clients judge BPX on whether projects land on time and on budget, which makes this role central to how they see us. Internally, this position maps to our Project Manager role within our global structure.
What you'll do

• Lead concurrent projects across Adobe and Salesforce, from platform upgrades to full enterprise implementations.

• Direct technical teams of consultants and platform specialists deploying front-office solutions inside complex client environments.

• Keep clients confident through clear status reporting and honest risk conversations with executive stakeholders.

• Hold every project to margin, managing budget, resourcing and revenue reporting against target.

• Report the financials accurately for implementation projects and retained services engagements alike.

• Run delivery in Kantata and Jira, tracking project health and resource allocation, with AI flagging risks earlier.

• Pick the right method for each engagement, waterfall or agile, and adjust when the project changes shape.

• You'll work with clients and colleagues across multiple regions, so some flexibility with your working hours to accommodate different time zones will be needed from time to time.

What you'll bring

• Enterprise delivery experience: 8+ years managing technology implementations for enterprise clients, ideally in a consultancy.

• Adobe or Salesforce depth, having delivered Adobe Experience Cloud or Salesforce projects and understood the technical detail.

• Multi-project control, with a track record of running several client projects at once without losing the thread.

• Commercial ownership of project budgets, margin, change requests and statements of work.

• Executive presence to lead status meetings and hard conversations about risk with senior client stakeholders.

• Waterfall and agile fluency; PMP, PRINCE2 or Scrum certification is a plus.

• Delivery tooling know-how in PSA and work-tracking platforms such as Kantata and Jira.
Why this role, why now
BPX is growing on private equity backing, and each new Adobe and Salesforce client adds projects that need someone to run them well. You'll step into a varied enterprise portfolio with direct access to client executives

title: Mission Engineer - Tampa
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

This isn't a relationship management role. It's an ownership role. Sharp. Adaptable. Unstoppable.

You won't wait to be asked. You'll identify what's broken before it becomes a problem, build solutions that didn't exist yesterday, and earn the kind of trust that makes you indispensable to the agency - and to Axon.

In this embedded role, you are the primary owner of customer outcomes within a strategic account - accountable for the full lifecycle of Axon's ecosystem. You combine deep technical expertise, builder instinct, operational leadership, and executive presence to help agencies transform how they operate, not just adopt software. You embed for the long haul: opening the laptop onsite, shipping on Axon's stack, holding the room when it matters, and iterating on what you build until it sticks in production.

Success is measured by the agency's operational outcomes and working solutions in production - not product health, not activity, not slideware.

What You'll Do

This role is intentionally undefined in the day-to-day. Priorities shift with agency mission tempo, operational crises, and emerging opportunities. If you need a fixed playbook to succeed, this isn't the role for you.

Building is the job. You will use Axon's platform - AI Era, agents, workflows, integrations, and data tools - to design, build, and ship new capabilities on site. You own outcomes end to end across deployment, adoption, optimization, and ongoing success - as the accountable owner, not a coordinator of other teams' work.

Onsite Building & Platform Delivery

• Discover agency problems onsite and translate them into buildable, compliant solutions tied to mission outcomes

• Design and ship working tools on Axon's platform: AI agents, workflows, automations, integrations, and data pipelines - built and tested with real users and real data

• Build with Axon products, not around them - configure, integrate, and extend DEMS, Fusus, AI Era, Records, and related systems in the agency environment

• Iterate in the field until adoption sticks, then document patterns for reuse across accounts

• Apply responsible innovation guardrails - CJIS, evidence integrity, privacy - in every build. Ship working software, not slideware

• Troubleshoot onsite and coordinate root-cause resolution across Product, Engineering, Support, and Services when builds or integrations break

AI Build & Adoption

• Build and deploy AI-powered workflows (agents, prompts, RAG, evaluations) that solve defined agency problems - not generic experimentation

• Drive hands-on adoption with the people who use what you build daily

• Measure whether changes stick - usage, workflow impact, mission outcomes - and iterate when they don't

Operational Transformation & Leadership

• Assess workflows onsite, identify friction and mission impact, and define what to build before you build it

• Move from reactive support to proactive outcome design - arrive with hypotheses, validate with command staff and operators, then build to match

• Build trusted relationships with agency leadership and operational stakeholders; lead QBRs, mission reviews, and strategic planning

• Define success metrics and capture baselines before major deployments so impact is proven, not assumed

title: Senior Reverse Engineer - Remote
description:
At Zyte , we're pioneering the next revolution in web data extraction, empowering businesses to focus on innovation. Companies often struggle with challenges like navigating dynamic web structures, countering anti-scraping measures, and ensuring data accuracy. We tackle these obstacles by providing best-in-class tools for seamless, reliable web data extraction. With over a decade of expertise, we've become the trusted solution for over 3,000 companies and a million developers, helping them achieve a competitive edge and drive sustainable growth.
We are a diverse and enthusiastic team of data nerds, tech aficionados, and hackers. At Zyte , you'll join an inclusive community where everyone belongs. We thrive on collaborating with our smart, passionate teammates and customers to solve complex problems in data science and engineering.
Join us and be part of the data revolution!

About the Job
Reverse engineering is at the heart of how Zyte stays ahead in the banning war. We've cracked some of the hardest antibots on the web - but the ground shifts weekly: antibots ship new sensor formats overnight, obfuscation schemes mutate, and new fingerprinting surfaces appear faster than any team could chase by hand.
This role is not about solving tickets one at a time. It's about building the tools, pipelines, and automation that let both engineers and AI agents solve them at scale. You will be the person who turns a reverse-engineering breakthrough into reusable tooling, who automates the investigation that used to take days into a readout that takes minutes, and who feeds the intelligence our AI systems learn from. You'll work at the intersection of deep JS/VM reverse engineering and modern AI-assisted engineering - using LLMs and agentic tooling aggressively to compress the loop between "new detection surface discovered" and "solution shipped."
If you're energized by wielding AI to multiply your own output, by automating away manual toil, and by working on problems where the adversary is smart and the target moves - this is the seat.
Requirements
Roles & Responsibilities

• Reverse-engineer the hardest antibot and fingerprinting systems on the web, across JS VMs, WASM, and polymorphic/obfuscated code.

• Build the JS function tracing, deobfuscation pipelines, and fingerprint-inspection tooling that turn manual reverse-engineering investigations into fast, repeatable, largely automated workflows.

• Use AI aggressively - LLMs, agents, and custom automation - to deobfuscate, classify, and diagnose detection surfaces, and to rapidly prototype and ship tooling that previously would have taken weeks.

• Build and maintain website intel pipelines with checkpointed history, so that when an antibot ships an update we diff against a known-good baseline instead of rediscovering the problem from scratch.

• Feed our AI reverse-engineering and ban-resolution systems the context, signals, and structured intelligence they need to autonomously resolve the majority of cases.

• Codify one-off reverse-engineering wins into durable capability - tools, rules, and pipelines usable by other engineers and by AI agents alike.

• Collaborate across engineering to fold your tooling into the custom browser and automation stack, and mentor others in AI-augmented reverse-engineering technique.

Requirements

• A hacker mindset - able to rapidly develop proof-of-concepts and working tools to get to a result, and comfortable with the inherent uncertainty and open-endedness of the work.

• Demonstrated use of AI tooling (LLMs, coding agents, automation) to accelerate your own engineering, with a strong instinct for what to automate and when.

• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/Node.js and Python, with a broad programming background and exceptional problem-solving ability.

• Strong research, debugging, fuzzing, and reverse-engineering skills, including static, dynamic, and concolic analysis.

• Hands-on experience reversing JavaScript VMs, WASM, and heavily obfuscated

This is a senior, hands on role owning the systems that run CloudM ’s revenue operating model. Salesforce sits at the centre of it and you will be accountable for it. You will inherit a platform that has grown quickly alongside the business, so your job is to stabilise it, document it, rationalise the automation that has accumulated, and run it as a dependable foundation for Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance as we scale.
Broadly, the shape of the role is:

• Salesforce platform ownership, remediation and day to day support: around 85%

• DealHub quoting administration: around 10%

• HubSpot maintenance and support: under 5%

You will be the only internal Salesforce specialist, with an external Salesforce partner available for deep technical work. That means you need the judgement to know what to build yourself, what to hand out, and how to hold a supplier to a standard.

• Data quality and reporting: Regular audits, de duplication and health checks, plus reports and dashboards covering pipeline, funnel conversion, renewals and forecasting inputs. Understand the question behind the request and offer a view, not just the numbers.

• Integrations: Maintain the Salesforce to HubSpot sync and support Marketing’s use of the platform.

• External delivery: Own the relationship with our external Salesforce partner. Write clear requirements, challenge proposed designs, test and accept delivered work, and make sure it is documented and maintainable in house.

• Documentation and enablement: Keep system and process documentation current, produce simple guides, run drop in sessions, and promote good data habits across the business.

In your first six months we would expect the org properly documented, a prioritised remediation plan agreed with the highest risk items delivered, the support queue running to a predictable and visible standard, and DealHub quoting configuration aligned to current commercial guardrails.

Run the plan across Atlas workstreams

- 10+ years of project or program management experience in a technology, SaaS, or managed services environment.

- Bachelors Degree or equivalent with some Post-Graduate work (or equivalent experience) and/or 12 years of related experience

- PMP certification and strong command of planning, sequencing, dependency management, and risk tracking.

- Ability to alternate between tactical execution and strategic planning, and to keep both moving at once.

- Experience working across engineering, sales, strategy, delivery, and finance teams, and comfort owning outcomes across teams you do not manage.

- Working knowledge of outsourcing and BPO delivery models, including capacity and staffing planning.

Sr. Digital Product Manager, Product Operations - Playbook & Training

The Senior Product Manager, Product Operations - Playbook & Training will help scale Amgen ’s Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) by creating, maintaining, and facilitating the practical materials teams need to adopt product ways of working. • Partner with the Director, Product Operations and Product Management Hub leadership to ensure playbook content reflects enterprise product management standards.

Templates and Reusable Assets

• Create and maintain templates, examples, self-serve guides, checklists, workshop materials, and other accelerators that help teams adopt DPOM.

• Own version control, content hygiene, distribution, and socialization of DPOM materials across relevant enterprise channels.

Training and Accelerator Workshops

description:
Our client in the US is a family-founded brand committed to making early learning engaging, screen-free, and fun. Their journey began with hand-drawn educational tools and has grown into a beloved brand, trusted by millions of parents, grandparents, and teachers. They design developmentally sound products for children ages 3 to 8, such as educational posters, busy books, and emotional learning kits. Their mission is to create tools that help children thrive through connection, curiosity, and real learning.
Their vision is bold. They want to become the most trusted children's brand in the world, present in millions of homes and passed down for generations, and they are building toward $100M in revenue by 2030.
Role Overview
They are hiring a Director of Ecommerce to own their Shopify business as its general manager. You will own the Shopify P&L and the growth engine that feeds it, from paid acquisition and creative testing to offers, funnels, and lifecycle marketing, and you will build the team and systems that let the channel scale without the founder in the day to day.
Shopify is their dominant D2C channel, and it does not stand alone. Their Amazon team owns Amazon, and TikTok Shop is an important part of their ecosystem. You will see the whole customer life cycle across Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop, including the halo their launches create on Amazon and how acquisition converts there, and you will connect the dots so a launch lifts all three.
Your target is to scale our direct-to-consumer business to $20M+ in profitable revenue, with a net margin of at least 15% on Shopify.
You will work closely with the CEO, partner with the Amazon team so every launch lifts both channels, and lead the ecommerce team.

What You'll Own

•
The P&L. Own Shopify revenue and profitability, with a net profit margin of at least 15%.

•
Customer acquisition. Run Meta and other paid media to unit economics, with a Meta ROAS of at least 2.5, and keep a high-velocity creative testing rhythm fed by the AI content engine, creator video, UGC, and in-house production.

•
Offers, funnels, and CRO. Launch new funnels that meet the KPI thresholds every month, build bundles and ascension paths, and keep homepage, collection, and product pages aligned with what converts.

•
Lifecycle and LTV. Drive email and SMS to at least 25% of Shopify revenue through Klaviyo and Postscript, and keep the 30-day GPLTV to CAC ratio above 3.

•
Channel connection. Partner with the Amazon team so every launch lifts Amazon too, understand TikTok Shop's place as a social-commerce channel, and keep each channel's role in the customer journey deliberate.

•
Team leadership. Lead the ecommerce operators with clear ownership, weekly operating rhythms, and scorecards, and bring in freelancers and contractors as output grows.

•
Reporting. Deliver a weekly scorecard and P&L review, and a monthly plan and forecast for the CEO.

•
Systems and compliance. Document a playbook for every working funnel, keep the store and ads compliant, and turn repeat work into AI-assisted workflows.

•
Brand. Protect and build what the brand stands for in every ad, page, and customer touchpoint.

How Success Is Measured

• Profitable growth in Shopify revenue against the plan.

• Net profit margin of at least 15% on Shopify.

• Meta ROAS of at least 2.5.

• Email and SMS at 25% or more of Shopify revenue.

• 30-day GPLTV to CAC above 3.

• A team and operating rhythm that run without daily founder involvement.

Requirements

You are a high ownership leader who thinks like a general manager, not just a marketer. You are energized by building systems, leading people, and owning outcomes.

• You have 5 to 10+ years of experience scaling DTC ecommerce brands on Shopify with paid social.

• You have a proven track record growing brands beyond $20M in revenue.

title: Senior Motion Planning Engineer

Mission Summary:

On our Motion Planning team, you'll apply your passion in robotics and software development for production-ready autonomous vehicles. In this role you'll perform cutting-edge research, develop advanced algorithms, and build robust software to generate safe, comfortable, and intuitive routes and motions.
Role responsibilities:

• Lead the research and development of novel algorithms for motion planning in autonomous driving, including but not limited to advanced search-based methods, sophisticated geometry-based methods, and decision making under uncertainty with a strong emphasis on probabilistic approaches.

• Architect and integrate complex combinations of motion planning and prediction algorithms, driving their evaluation and refinement for real-world deployment.

• Design and build a robust, scalable, and high-performance codebase that facilitates rapid exploration, prototyping, and rigorous evaluation of innovative motion planning approaches and algorithms.

• Drive technical collaboration and interface seamlessly with perception and prediction components upstream and trajectory optimization, tracking and control components downstream, ensuring end-to-end system performance.

• Guide and mentor junior team members, cultivating a culture of product-focused engineering, rigorous research, and advanced development.

• PhD preferred in Robotics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field; or a Master's degree with 2+ years of experience in the robotics (preferably AV industry)

• 5+ years of research experience in robotics / motion planning, with a proven track record of contributing to state-of-the-art solutions

• 3+ years of C++ software development, with an emphasis on developing high-performance and reliable systems

• Past experience owning and leading technical development on complex features from problem formulation through research, implementation, and deployment in a production environment.

• Thirst for knowledge, continuous innovation, and a drive to push the boundaries of autonomous driving technology.

Bonus points(not required):

• Experience with probabilistic models, including but not limited to Gaussian mixture models, Hidden Markov Models, and Particle Filters.

• Experience with the Bazel build framework

title: Senior AI Developer
description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

We're looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior AI Engineer to join our ClickUp Engineering team, with a focus on AI evaluations. You'll own how we measure and improve the quality of ClickUp's AI: building the eval systems that tell us how well our AI is performing, the core agent harness, and the AI that performs well on those evals. You'll work on backend systems that make AI-powered capabilities scalable, reliable, and secure, while working hands-on with LLMs to solve real user problems and drive product innovation.

 

Key Responsibilities:

- Design, build, and own ClickUp's AI evaluation system, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge and automated scorers, regression detection, and quality tracking across AI features.

- Build and evolve the core agent harness, and the AI that performs well on those evals, partnering closely with product and engineering to define what "great" looks like.

- Build self-improvement loops where agents modify other agents or prompts, rerun evals, and iterate automatically.

- Benchmark new models as they're released and own model selection, routing, and fallback strategies across providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-weight), balancing quality, latency, and cost.

- Architect, design, and implement scalable AI platform services that support the deployment, orchestration, and lifecycle management of LLMs and other AI models.

- Build and maintain robust APIs and backend systems that integrate AI-powered features into ClickUp's core platform.

- Develop infrastructure for model serving, monitoring, logging, and automated evaluation to ensure high reliability and performance of AI services in production.

- Drive best practices in AI privacy, security, and compliance, including data anonymization, secure data handling, and regulatory adherence.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with product, frontend, and data teams to deliver seamless, reliable, and user-centric AI experiences.

 

Qualifications:

- 5+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years building production LLM or ML systems.

- Hands-on experience building LLM evaluation systems in production (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, judge calibration, offline and online evals), tied to real product quality.

- Strong experiment design and statistical rigor, including A/B testing, offline vs. online metrics, and separating real regressions from noisy or variable results.

- Proven track record of applying LLMs and AI models to real-world, customer-facing product features.

- Proven experience integrating and managing multiple LLMs, including benchmarking, routing, and cost/latency/quality tradeoffs.

- Deep expertise in backend engineering, distributed systems, and cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker, AWS/GCP/Azure).

- Strong programming skills in Python (preferred), Go, TypeScript, or similar languages used for backend and AI platform development.

- Proficiency in orchestration frameworks and workflow engines (e.g., LangGraph, Airflow, Ray, or similar).

- Familiarity with search and retrieval technologies and their integration into AI-driven applications.

- Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of working effectively in cross-functional teams.

- Passion for staying at the forefront of AI and applying new technologies to solve real-world problems at scale.

 

Nice to Have:

- Background in data science, applied science, or machine learning engineering.

- Experience with eval tooling (e.g., Braintrust, LangSmith, Weave, Arize, or in-house frameworks).

- Experience with model routing, AI

title: Stage - Ingénieur Structure Offshore - Etude Impact Module sans Bracons - F/H
description:
Soyez acteur de la solution avec Technip Energies et rejoignez-nous pour une carrière unique. Vous contribuerez à développer des solutions de pointe pour résoudre les problèmes énergétiques auxquels notre monde est confronté.
Technip Energies est une entreprise de technologies et d’ingénierie de premier plan. Leader dans le GNL, l’hydrogène, l’éthylène, la chimie durable et la gestion du CO2, nous contribuons au développement de marchés stratégiques tels que l'énergie, les dérivés énergétiques, la décarbonation et la circularité. Nos segments d’activité complémentaires, Technologies, Produits et Services (TPS) et Livraison de Projet, transforment les innovations en réalité industrielle à grande échelle.
Animés par des valeurs de collaboration et d’excellence dans l’exécution, plus de 17 000 collaborateurs dans 34 pays s'engagent pour allier prospérité et durabilité en faveur d’un monde conçu pour durer.
Missions proposées :
Les unités flottantes offshore sont constituées de plusieurs modules.
Chacun de ces modules est un ensemble de Poutres, Colonnes tubulaires et Bracons horizontaux et verticaux tubulaires.
L’objectif de ces Bracons est d’assurer la stabilité de la charpente durant les différentes phases de la vie de la plate-forme.
L’objectif du stage est de faire une étude comparative d’un module, avec et sans les Bracons verticaux :

• Impact sur la stabilité et les deflections

• Impact sur le dimensionnement (tenue a la charge et fatigue)

• Impact sur la constructabilité

• Impact sur le poids et le centre de gravité

L’étude devra souligner les éventuels limitations et/ou champ d’application
Lors de ce stage, vous serez accompagné(e) par un(e) tuteur/tutrice pour répondre à vos différentes questions. Ce stage sera pour vous, l’occasion de monter en compétences, connaissances.
Profil recherché:
Nous serions heureux de vous rencontrer et d’échanger sur votre adéquation à ce poste. Pour réussir cette mission, vous devrez remplir les conditions suivantes :

• En cours de Bac +5 en ingénierie des structures offshore ou ingénierie navale ou mécanique

• Vous avez des connaissances en RDM et calculs de charpentes métalliques

• Vous avez un anglais opérationnel (oral & écrit)

title: Enterprise Account Executive - East
description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

The Mission

We are living through the most significant technological shift since the dawn of the internet. At Kong, we aren't just watching the AI revolution, we are building the infrastructure that makes it possible. We are the intelligent nervous system for modern architecture, seamlessly connecting APIs, microservices, and LLMs for the world’s most ambitious brands.

As enterprises race to integrate AI, they face a wall of complexity. We are the bridge. We help the global 2000 modernize their legacy systems and securely unlock the power of AI across their entire organization. This isn't just sales; it’s architecting the future of global commerce.

The Role: Impact & Ownership

We are looking for a strategic, high-achieving, and disciplined Enterprise Account Executive to join our world-class team. At Kong, we don't leave success to chance. We are a "master the craft" company. We rely on proven frameworks, deep technical curiosity, and collaborative execution.

If you thrive when navigating complex, high-stakes deals and love the challenge of selling transformational technology to visionary CTOs and Chief Architects, you’ve found your next home.

What You Will Achieve

- Pioneer New Markets: Lead the full sales cycle to welcome new six- and seven-figure enterprise partners into the Kong ecosystem.

- Master the Framework: Use the MEDDIC methodology not just as an acronym, but as a strategic tool to uncover value, mitigate risk, and drive predictable success.

- Navigate the C-Suite: Orchestrate complex, multi-threaded sales cycles, building deep trust with everyone from lead engineers to C-level executives.

- Collaborative Excellence: Partner with our expert Solutions Engineering team to prove the massive ROI and technical superiority of the Kong platform.

- Define Your Legacy: Maintain a pristine pipeline and deliver accurate forecasts that help shape the strategic direction of our sales organization.

What You Bring to the Journey

- A Track Record of Excellence: 8+ years of experience selling complex enterprise software platforms, with a history of consistently exceeding goals and reaching the top tier of your organization.

- Technical Curiosity: You have a passion for infrastructure, DevOps, or AI-enabling technologies. You don't just sell the product; you understand the "why" behind it.

- Strategic Discipline: You value a structured approach. You know that sustainable, scalable success comes from mastering the playbook and executing with precision.

- Executive Presence: You are a compelling storyteller, capable of articulating the strategic business value of AI and APIs to the world’s most sophisticated technical leaders.

- Resilient Drive: You bring the persistence, grit, and proactive mindset required to win in a high-velocity, competitive landscape.

Why You’ll Thrive at Kong

- Category-Defining Technology: Sell a product that engineers genuinely love and that the world’s largest companies need to survive an AI-first world.

- Uncapped Opportunity: A competitive base salary paired with an aggressive, uncapped commission structure that rewards those who go above and beyond.

- Exponential Growth: We are scaling fast and we invest in our people. If you want to grow your career, we provide the path, the training, and the mentorship to get you there.

- Inclusive Excellence: We offer comprehensive health coverage, equity, flexible PTO, and a culture where diverse perspectives are the fuel for our innovation.

Our Commitment to You: At Kong, we believe that talent is diverse by nature. If you are excited about this role but your background doesn't perfectly match every single bullet point, we encourage you to apply anyway.

title: Authorizations Specialist (WFH)
description:
About FGC+

#SparkSuccess at FGC+ !

Since 2011, FGC+ has been committed to transforming US businesses through our all-inclusive outsourcing solutions. Through the years, we've built strong remote teams, developed customized processes, and provided exceptional customer service, helping companies soar to new heights. Our dedicated professionals excel in supporting a diverse range of industries with unmatched dedication.

Driven by our core values of Empathy, Reliability, Possibility, and Growth, we are focused on #IgnitingPossibility and helping each team member unlock their full potential. At FGC+ , we offer more than just a job; we provide a nurturing environment where work-life balance, mentorship, employee engagement, and continuous learning are the pillars of your success.

Here, you are more than just an employee -you are part of a team where you can truly thrive and make a difference.

About the Job:

Be part of a team that helps patients access the healthcare services they need! As an Authorization Specialist, you will play a vital role in bridging the gap between patients, healthcare providers, and insurance companies. You will review clinical documentation, coordinate authorizations and referrals, and work directly with insurance providers to secure medical necessity approvals. Through your attention to detail and effective communication, you will help ensure patients receive timely access to appropriate healthcare services while supporting providers in delivering quality care.

What You'll Do:

• Manage and process daily authorization requests from healthcare providers and facilities, ensuring timely and accurate completion.

• Initiate authorization requests through various insurance portals and direct communication with insurance companies.

• Follow up on pending authorizations, track their status, and address any delays or concerns.

• Prepare and process appeals for denied authorization requests.

• Advocate for patients and providers by coordinating with insurance companies to secure approvals across different levels of care.

• Collaborate with healthcare providers to obtain necessary documentation and clarify medical necessity requirements.

• Respond to inquiries from insurance companies, document relevant information, and communicate updates to providers.

• Review and interpret medical records to identify relevant clinical information needed for authorization requests.

• Maintain accurate account records and update documentation in accordance with client guidelines and established processes.

• Ensure all required forms, logs, and reports are completed accurately, thoroughly, and on time.

What You'll Bring:

• Previous experience in healthcare accounts, medical-related projects, or a similar field.

• Experience in Pre-Authorization, Utilization Review, or Case Management is a strong advantage.

• Strong probing, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills to assess clinical information and address authorization concerns effectively.

• Ability to read, understand, and identify relevant information from medical records and clinical documentation.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally with healthcare providers, insurance companies, clients, and colleagues.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling documentation, authorization requests, and account updates.

• Ability to prioritize, organize, and manage multiple tasks while meeting deadlines.

• Proficiency in general computer applications, particularly Microsoft Word, Excel, and PDF tools.

• Ability to quickly learn and navigate new software systems and applications.

• Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively as part of a team.

• Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and processes.

A million possibilities are waiting to be ignited. Click "Apply Now"!

The Account Executive, Strategic Health Partnerships is a quota-carrying, fully sales-focused role responsible for winning new pharmaceutical, life sciences, and healthcare customers. Thrive Global helps pharma partners combine breakthrough medicines and Thrive’s science-backed behavior change methodology to support patients across their health journey, whether managing a disease state, participating in a clinical trial, or simply trying to increase longevity and quality of life. The role owns the sales cycle from first conversation to close, with a primary focus on new logos and additional responsibility for expansion in signed accounts.

This is a builder role. The Account Executive works opportunities from senior leadership and assigned accounts, and also generates new pipeline through their own network and market intelligence. Reporting to the VP, Sales & Partnerships, and supported by the GTM Strategy team, the Account Executive works closely with Product, Content, Legal, and Executive Leadership. • Research and prioritize target companies by therapeutic area, portfolio, and market dynamics.

• Position patient engagement, patient support, clinical trial engagement and retention, and communications solutions, along with the broader Thrive platform.

• Build relationships across pharma prospects, from patient engagement, clinical, commercial, and direct-to-consumer site leaders up to the C-suite, and identify the economic buyer and champion early.

• Identify and close projects and expansion opportunities in signed accounts, working alongside Customer Success.

• Develop proposals, pilots, and commercial structures with Product, Content, and Finance, tied to outcomes such as adherence, engagement, retention, and brand trust.

• Work with Legal and the customer’s MLR, compliance, privacy, and procurement teams through contracting and review.

Parallel Squared Technology Institute (PTI) is a non-profit research institute aiming to  catalyze a leap in protein analysis technology and use it to explore new biological frontiers. PTI supports open research and educational opportunities supporting rapid career development for scientists, engineers, and mathematicians.
 
Why? Protein dysfunctions directly cause many diseases, such as Alzheimer’s disease. Yet, proteins remain understudied because of technological hurdles.

Scientists at and collaborating with the institute will use these gains to directly investigate disease mechanisms and resolve problems that have proven intractable for decades. Our proof of principle technology and strategies are outlined at: parallelsq.org.
 
PTI’s new approach requires synergy between a diverse team of chemists, machine learning engineers, biologists and mass spectrometrists. Alzheimer’s disease and aging will be among the first focuses of this technology-driven research organization.

Karius is a venture-backed life science company transforming how pathogens and other microbes are detected throughout the body. By unlocking the information present in microbial cell-free DNA, we help physicians solve some of their most challenging infectious disease cases, accelerate biomarker discovery and clinical trials for industry partners, and ultimately reduce patient suffering worldwide.

Position Summary

This is an opportunity to join a growing life sciences company at the forefront of infectious disease diagnostics. Karius is expanding the adoption of its proprietary next-generation sequencing test across hospitals and health systems in the United States. Joining Karius offers the chance to accelerate your career while contributing to a mission that has a direct impact on patient care.

The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) plays a critical role in Karius ’ commercial strategy by driving proactive outbound engagement and early-stage opportunity creation within a defined, region-based territory. The ISR focuses on initiating new conversations, securing meetings, and creating early commercial momentum, particularly within low-activity or early-stage hospital accounts.

Working in close partnership with Clinical Sales Managers (CSMs) and Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs), the ISR owns the front end of the customer journey, progressing opportunities to a qualified meeting and ensuring a smooth handoff to the field team for continued development.

Outbound Prospecting & Meeting Generation

• Secure qualified meetings with appropriate clinical, laboratory, and administrative decision-makers

Early-Stage Account Engagement

• Own early engagement for assigned low-volume or low-activity hospital and health system accounts

• Identify unmet needs, access gaps, and opportunities for further engagement

• Progress accounts to a defined next step, culminating in a qualified meeting for CSM/MSL handoff

Event and Program Conversion

• Support regional events, speaker programs, and conferences through pre-event outreach and post-event follow-up

• Convert event engagement into scheduled meetings and qualified opportunities

Opportunity & Activity Management

• Accurately document outreach, interactions, and meetings in Salesforce

• Maintain visibility into ISR-owned activity, opportunity progression, and handoff status

Why Should You Join Us?

Karius is advancing infectious disease diagnostics through innovations in genomics, machine learning, and clinical science. Our platform delivers unprecedented insight into the microbial landscape, providing physicians with powerful tools to diagnose complex infections and improve patient outcomes. As part of the Karius team, your work will have a meaningful and measurable impact on patient care at scale.

Location: GreaterSalt Lake City, Utah area

title: Configuration/Source Code Repository Lead
description:
Overview

The Configuration Manager sets up and sustains Git-based source control for the Remote Order Entry System (ROES) on the Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program. ROES is a large VistA code base written in MUMPS (M) and hosted on InterSystems Caché or IRIS. VistA code has traditionally been managed in routine and global files rather than in file-based repositories. This role bridges that world and modern DevSecOps. The Configuration Manager exports routines and related artifacts into a structured GitHub repository, defines branching and check-in/check-out practices that fit M development, and builds automation so code moves reliably between Caché namespaces and environments. After the initial setup, the role maintains configuration baselines and release integrity over the application's lifecycle.

We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.
TISTA associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!

Responsibilities

Repository Setup and Architecture

• Design the GitHub organization and repository structure for a large MUMPS code base, including package-based directory layouts (for example, one directory per VistA package or namespace) and a decision on monorepo versus multi-repo.

• Establish the repository as the source of truth by exporting routines (.m or .int files), data dictionaries, and other artifacts, and by reconciling differences between development, test, and production accounts.

• Configure teams, roles, and least-privilege access integrated with VA identity services, and handle large files and binary artifacts appropriately.

Branching, Merging, and Check-In/Check-Out for M Code

• Define, document, and enforce a branching strategy suited to VistA patch cadence (for example, trunk-based with short-lived feature branches, plus release and hotfix branches tied to patch streams).

• Establish conventions for routine naming, namespace ownership, line-level formatting, and commit messages that reference patch or work item IDs.

• Configure branch protection, required reviews, CODEOWNERS by package, and status checks.

• Resolve merge conflicts specific to M code, such as concurrent edits to shared routines, and coach developers who are new to Git on pull request workflows.

• Provide guidance on keeping Caché namespaces and Git branches synchronized, including import and export procedures for developers working in Studio, VS Code (with the InterSystems ObjectScript extension), or terminal sessions.

Workflow Streamlining and Automation

• Build CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (self-hosted runners as needed inside the VA boundary) or comparable tools to import code into disposable Caché or IRIS test instances, compile routines, and run automated tests.

• Integrate M-aware quality gates, such as the M-Unit testing framework, static analysis and standards checking (for example, XINDEX-style checks or open-source M linters), and routine size and structure checks.

• Automate KIDS build and patch assembly, packaging, and installation into target environments where permitted.

• Use containerized Caché or IRIS instances for repeatable build and test environments, where approved.

• Link commits to Jira or other work items for end-to-end traceability, and standardize issue, pull request, and workflow templates.
